purpose: Make RallyHub testing repeatable and enforceable for ChatGPT, third-party testers, browser agents, security tools and human testers.

mandatory_protocol_declaration.text: I am testing RallyHub under Master Testing Blueprint v1.4 and RallyHub Testing Control Pack v1.0. I will not substitute my own testing process for the required protocol without recording and justifying the deviation.

third_party_rules: Load and declare the current Master Testing Blueprint and Control Pack versions before testing.
Use the supplied Test Run Brief; do not replace it with an undocumented private test plan.
Run the Risk Gate before executing tests and do not select a shallower depth than the gate requires.
Identify the exact target commit/checkpoint/build and environment before recording results.
Protect production data and use approved sandbox/dummy data for destructive or high-volume tests.
Record PASS, PASS-WITH-LIMITATION, FAIL or BLOCKED with evidence for every required test case.
A harness/environment failure is BLOCKED unless the RallyHub application itself rendered and violated an assertion.
Do not call a sandbox-only pass release-ready; prove the exact tested edits are persisted.
Do not call a republish deployed until the production release is fingerprinted against the intended candidate.
Record every deviation from the brief, why it was necessary, and whether it reduces confidence.
Do not suppress failed tests. Continue independent tests where safe and return a complete failure list.

For meaningful user-facing workflows, complete the end-to-end handover journey before handback: discovery, instructions, setup, primary action, result interpretation, zero/error state, and mobile where relevant. The user must not be the first integration tester.
Any meaningful defect fixed during the run must receive a regression test wherever practical.
